difficulty_reason: Transitivity of the fiber-functor automorphism group G on the points of a connected object of a Galois category: the Galois objects form a directed poset I (fiber products and the Galois-object lemma); F is isomorphic to colim_I Mor(X_i, -) via the normalized choice of base points gamma_i (injective by the one-element axiom, surjective by reduction to connected Galois objects); the automorphism groups A_i = Aut(X_i) form a surjective inverse system with profinite limit A acting on F' so A^opp -> G is surjective; connected objects are dominated by some X_i. Retained author proof at lines 757-826.
